howto.name: Upload an SRT / VTT / ASS subtitle file
howto.text: The format is detected from the file's content.

howto.name: Choose target format
howto.text: SRT (universal) or VTT (web video). ASS files can be read but not written.

faq.q: What's the difference between SRT and VTT?
faq.a: SRT is the simplest format. VTT (WebVTT) is the one HTML5 video players load through their track element, and it supports styling. ASS (Advanced SubStation Alpha) allows rich styling such as karaoke colours, but fewer players support it.

Text and timing always carry over, and inline tags such as italics are copied as they are. WebVTT cue settings (position and alignment) and STYLE blocks are dropped, and ASS styling and override codes are removed.
